div.head: AGu Prol.
div.ab: Ðis is þæt frið, ðæt Ælfred cyng ⁊ Guðrum cing ⁊ ealles Angelcynnes witan ⁊ eal seo ðeod ðe on Eastenglum beoð, ⁊ gesworen habbað, ge for hy sylfe ge for heora ofspryng.

Ðis is ðæt frið, ðæt Ælfred cyninc ⁊ Gyðrum cyning ⁊ ealles Angelcynnes witan ⁊ eal seo ðeod ðe on Eastænglum beoð ealle gecweden habbað ⁊ mid aðum gefeostnod for hy sylfe ⁊ for heora gingran, ge for geborene ge for ungeborene, ðe Godes miltse recce oððe ure.

Hęc sunt pacis agenda, que Ælfredus rex et Godrun rex et omnes Anglię sapientes et omnis populus, qui in Eastanglia manet, constituerunt et iureiurando confirmauerunt pro se ipsis et iunioribus suis, progenitis et ingenitis, qui Dei misericordiam diligunt et nostram.

[Ælfredes laga cyninges.] [Ld] Ðis is ðæt frið, ðæt Ælfred cyninc ⁊ Gyðrum cyning ⁊ ealles Angelcynnes witan ⁊ eal seo ðeod ðe on Eastænglum beoð ealle gecweden habbað ⁊ mid aðum gefeostnod for hy selfe ⁊ heora gingran, ge for geborene ge for ungeborene, ðe Godes miltse reccen oððe ure.

These are the terms of peace which King Alfred and King Guthrum and the councillors of all the English nation, and all the people who dwell in East Anglia, have all agreed upon and confirmed with oaths, on their own behalf and for their subjects, both living and unborn, who are anxious for God's favour and ours.

This is the peace which King Alfred and King Guthrum and the councillors of all the English race and all the people which is in East Anglia have all agreed on and confirmed with oaths, for themselves and for their subjects, both for the living and those yet unborn, who care to have God’s grace or ours.

Dies ist der Friede, welchen König Aelfred und König Guthrum und die Witan der ganzen Englischen Nation und das ganze Volk, welches in Ostanglien ist, alle bestimmt und mit Eiden gefestigt (beschworen B2) haben für sich selbst und für ihre Nachkommen (Nachkommenschaft B2), so für geborene wie für noch nicht geborene, die Gottes Gnade erstreben oder die unsere.

This is the peace which King Alfred and King Guthrum and the councillors of the whole English nation and all the people who are in East Anglia have all determined and confirmed with oaths (sworn B2), for themselves and for their descendants (offspring B2), both born and not yet born, who seek God’s mercy or ours.
